mapper.sql: WHERE record_type='NOTIFICATION' AND notify_channel=#{channel} AND notify_status=#{status} AND alert_instance_id=#{alertId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,rule_code, alert_instance_id,notify_channel channel,notify_status status,retry_count attempts,max_retries,next_attempt_at, last_attempt_at,sent_at delivered_at,last_error_type error_type,last_error_summary error_summary, provider_message_id,created_at FROM t_alert_notification ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT notify_channel channel, COUNT(*) total,SUM(notify_status='DELIVERED') delivered,SUM(notify_status IN ('FAILED','DEAD_LETTER')) failed, SUM(notify_status='DEAD_LETTER' AND dead_letter_status='OPEN') open_dead_letters, ROUND(100*SUM(notify_status='DELIVERED')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) delivery_rate FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='NOTIFICATION' AND created_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) GROUP BY notify_channel ORDER BY notify_channel

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(notify_status IN ('PENDING','SENT','FAILED')),0) pending, COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(CASE WHEN notify_status IN ('PENDING','SENT','FAILED') THEN created_at END),NOW()),0) oldest_pending_seconds, COALESCE(SUM(notify_status='DEAD_LETTER' AND dead_letter_status='OPEN'),0) open_dead_letters FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='NOTIFICATION'
